newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - FRANCE - LE MONDE - JULY 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - FRANCE - LE MONDE - JULY 9.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Commission working on a reform of the legal system does not favour severing link between prosecutors and the state, call for a limitation of judges' prerogatives.

-- Prime Minister Lionel Jospin to allocate some ten billion francs to social measures including a "back to school" allowance, a program for wider access to school cafeterias, and housing and jobs programs for the young.
-- France Telecom to become largest shareholder in computer services group Sema Group, replacing Paribas.
-- Britain's GEC to pull out of Franco-British group GEC Alsthom ALSF.CN.
